pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with soft, low-frequency pixel gradients at the boundaries; edges lack sharp definition due to image resolution and focus.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Negative-space network of light-toned pelage forming a topological web between patches; primarily 3-way junction nodes are visible; pixel thickness is non-uniform across the observed flank.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark-toned, avian-shaped silhouette is visible on the lower-left lateral surface of the neck.
